title: 第6章 落难夫妻
content_zh:
过了山岭，黄昏时分已抵三道沟，那是一个不大不小的乡镇。司机说：“三道沟就只一家安通客栈。”进了乡，万澜武师和西日阿洪一行人都投安通客栈。西北处处荒凉，客栈土墙泥地，也就简陋得很。杨武不见前台出来迎接，大骂：“都死光了吗？我操你十八代祖宗！”崔莹眉头一皱，她可从来没听人敢当着她面骂这些粗话。

    一行人正要闯门，忽听屋里传出一阵阵武器相接之声。

    崔莹大喜：“又有热闹瞧啦！”抢先奔了进去。

    内堂里空无一人，到了院子，只见一个少妇披散了头发正和四个汉子恶斗。那少妇面容惨淡，左手刀长，右手刀短，刀光霍霍，以死相拼。崔莹见他们斗了几个回合，那几名汉子似想攻进房去，给那少妇舍命挡住。四条汉子武功均皆不弱，一使软鞭，一使怀杖。一使剑，一使鬼头刀。

    这时杜静芳也已走进院子，心想：“怎么一路上尽遇见会家子？”见那使怀杖的举双杖当头砸下，少妇不敢硬接，向左闪让。软鞭拦腰缠来，少妇左手刀刀势如风，直截敌人右腕。软鞭鞭梢倒卷，少妇长刀已收，没被卷着，鬼头刀却已砍来，同时一柄剑刺她后心。少妇右手刀挡开了剑，但敌人两下夹攻，鬼头刀这招竟避让不及，被直砍在左肩。

    她挨了这刀，兀自恶战不退，双刀挥动时点点鲜血四溅。那使软鞭的叫道：“捉活的，别伤她性命！”

    杜静芳见四男围攻一女，动了侠义之心，虽然自己身上负有重案，说不得要伸手管上一管。只见那使怀杖的双杖横打，少妇避开怀杖，百忙中右手短刀还他一刀，左方一剑刺来，少妇长刀斜格，对方膂力甚强，那少妇左肩受伤，气力大减，刀剑相交，一震之下，长刀呛啷一声掉在地下。敌人得理不让人，长剑乘势直进，少妇向右急闪，使鬼头刀的大汉在空挡中闯向店房。

    那少妇竟不顾身后攻来的武器，左手入怀，一扬手，两柄飞刀向敌人背心飞去。那人只道少妇有己方三个同伴缠住，并无后顾之忧，待听见脑后风声，避让已经不及，急忙低头，一柄飞刀插上了门框，另一柄却刺进了他背心。幸亏那少妇左肩受伤，手劲不足，这一刀尚非致命，但已痛得哇哇大叫，退了下来，把飞刀拔出。少妇此时又被怀杖打中一下，摇摇欲倒，见敌人退出，又即挡住房门。

    杜静芳对崔莹说：“你去替她解围。打不赢，老师帮你。”

    崔莹正自跃跃欲试，巴不得有这句话，一跃向前，挺剑一隔，喝道：“四个大男人打一个妇道人家，要脸么？”四条汉子见有人出头干预，己方又有人受伤，齐声呼啸，转身出店而去。

    那少妇已是面无人色，倚在门上直喘气。崔莹过去问：“他们干嘛欺负你？”少妇一时说不出话来。西日阿洪走过来对崔莹说：“夫人传唤。”放低声音说：“夫人听说您又跟人打架，吓坏啦。快请过去吧。”少妇见西日阿洪一身军装，脸色一变，也不答理崔莹，拔下门框上飞刀，砰的一声，把房门关上了。

    崔莹碰了这个软钉子，心中老大不自在，回头对西日阿洪说：“好，这就去。”走到杜静芳身边问：“老师，他们干嘛这样狠打恶杀？”杜静芳说：“多半是江湖上的仇杀。事情还没了呢，那四人还会找回来。”

    崔莹正想再问，忽听外面有人大吵大嚷：“操你奶奶，你说没贵宾房，怕老杨出不起钱吗？”听声音正是武师杨武。
content_en:
After crossing the mountains, we arrived at Sandaogou at dusk, which is a small and medium-sized town. The driver said: "There is only one Antong Inn in Sandaogou." After entering the countryside, Wanlan Martial Arts Master, Xiri Ahong and his party all stayed at the Antong Inn. The northwest is desolate everywhere, and the inn is very simple with earthen walls and mud floors. Yang Wu came out to greet him at the front desk and yelled: "Are everyone dead? I'll fuck your eighteenth generation ancestors!" Cui Ying frowned. She had never heard anyone dare to curse such foul words in front of her.

    The group of people were about to break through the door when they suddenly heard the sound of weapons clashing in the room.

    Cui Ying was overjoyed: "It's fun again!" She rushed in first.

    There was no one in the inner hall. When they arrived in the courtyard, they saw a young woman with her hair down and fighting fiercely with four men. The young woman's face was bleak. The sword in her left hand was long and the sword in her right hand was short. The sword was shining brightly, and she was fighting to the death. Cui Ying saw that they fought for several rounds, and the men seemed to want to attack the room, but the young woman risked her life to stop them. None of the four men are weak in martial arts, one uses the soft whip and the other uses the wand. One uses a sword, and the other uses a ghost-headed sword.

    At this time, Du Jingfang had also walked into the yard, thinking: "How come I didn't meet all the Huijiazi along the way?" Seeing the wielder of the cane raising his two sticks and hitting her head with two sticks, the young woman did not dare to take it hard and stepped to the left. The soft whip was wrapped around her waist, and the young woman's sword in her left hand was as powerful as the wind, piercing the enemy's right wrist. The tip of the soft whip was rolled back, and the young woman's long knife had been sheathed. It was not wrapped, but the ghost-headed knife had already slashed at her, and at the same time, a sword stabbed her in the back. The young woman blocked the sword with the sword in her right hand, but the enemy attacked from two sides, but the Ghost Head Saber was unable to avoid it and was slashed straight on the left shoulder.

    After receiving the knife, she fought fiercely and refused to retreat. Little bits of blood spattered everywhere as she swung the swords. The soft whip shouted: "If you catch her alive, don't hurt her life!"

    When Du Jingfang saw four men besieging a woman, she felt a sense of chivalry. Although she was involved in a serious case, she had no choice but to intervene. I saw the wielder's two staffs striking him horizontally. The young woman avoided the staff, and in her busy schedule, she returned a blow with the short sword in her right hand. A sword came from the left, and the young woman's long sword was slashed at an angle. The opponent's physical strength was very strong. The young woman's left shoulder was injured, and her strength was greatly reduced. The swords met, and the long sword fell to the ground with a clang. The enemy refused to let anyone take notice, and took advantage of the momentum to advance straight forward with the long sword. The young woman dodged sharply to the right, allowing the big man with the Ghost Head Sword to rush into the shop in the middle of the gap.

    The young woman actually ignored the weapons coming from behind, put her left hand into her arms, raised her hands, and flew two flying knives towards the enemy's vest. The man only thought that the young woman was entangled by three of his companions and had no worries. When he heard the wind behind his head, he had no time to avoid it. He hurriedly lowered his head and inserted a flying knife into the door frame, while the other pierced his vest. Fortunately, the young woman's left shoulder was injured and her hand strength was weak. The blow was not fatal, but she screamed in pain, retreated, and pulled out the flying knife. At this time, the young woman was hit by the stick again and was about to fall. When she saw the enemy retreating, she blocked the door.

    Du Jingfang said to Cui Ying: "Go and rescue her. If you can't win, the teacher will help you."

    Cui Yingzheng was eager to try, wishing for these words, she jumped forward, raised her sword and shouted: "Does it cost shame for four grown men to beat a woman?" When the four men saw that someone intervened and someone on their side was injured, they roared in unison, turned and left the shop.

    The young woman's face turned pale and she leaned against the door, panting. Cui Ying went over and asked, "Why are they bullying you?" The young woman was speechless for a moment. Xiri Ahong came over and said to Cui Ying, "Madam summons." He lowered his voice and said, "Madam heard that you were fighting with someone again, and you were frightened. Please come over quickly." When the young woman saw Xiri Ahong in military uniform, her expression changed, and she ignored Cui Ying. She pulled out the throwing knife from the door frame and closed the door with a bang.

    Cui Ying felt uncomfortable when she touched this soft nail. She turned around and said to Xiri Ahong: "Okay, let's go now." She walked to Du Jingfang and asked: "Teacher, why are they beating up the villains so hard?" Du Jingfang said: "It's probably a vendetta in the world. The matter is not over yet, and those four people will be found again."

    Cui Ying was about to ask again when she suddenly heard someone outside shouting: "Fuck you grandma, you said there is no VIP room, are you afraid that Lao Yang can't afford it?" The voice was that of the martial arts master Yang Wu.
